subject: A Quick Update and a Special Offer Just for You
html_email:
Hi there,

By the way, we’ve just launched a premium subscription plan: you’ll get 10% off every order, all year round. It’s our way of saying thanks for being part of our journey!

Let me know what you’d love to see personalized next. Talk soon!

Best,
The PaperCo Team
